title: Split editor JavaScript into Elementor editor modules
description: Refactor assets/js/eit-editor.js into bounded editor modules for cadence, listing detection, preset save flow, and compatibility fallback.
objective: Reduce the 1025-line editor script before more Elementor editor behavior is added.
acceptance_criteria: Elementor editor cadence behavior remains equivalent.
No Elementor private API dependency is deepened without a decision.
Each editor JS module stays below the plugin line budget.
verification: php scripts/verify-line-budget.php --strict passes or reports only tracked transition debt.
Guilherme QA handles broad visual/editor nuance after smoke checks.

budgets.context_budget: editor JS and Elementor widget controls

risks: Elementor editor hook timing can break if modules initialize in the wrong order.
Fallback behavior can become noisy or invisible if state is split poorly.
Saved widget model reads can regress if private API assumptions drift.
